SELECT a.id, a.category_id, a.title, a.description, a.cover, a.thumbnail, a.comment, a.comments, a.status, a.recommend, a.pv, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.year_time, a.month_time, c.name AS category_name FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id
ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.category_id, a.title, a.description, a.cover, a.thumbnail, a.comment, a.comments, a.status, a.recommend, a.pv, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.year_time, a.month_time, c.name AS category_name, ac.content FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN blog_article_content ac ON ac.article_id = a.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog_article (id, category_id, title, description, cover, thumbnail, comment, comments, status, recommend, pv, year_time, month_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{cover}, #{thumbnail}, #{comment}, #{comments}, #{status}, #{recommend}, #{pv}, #{yearTime}, #{monthTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE blog_article SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, cover = #{cover}, thumbnail = #{thumbnail}, comment = #{comment}, status = #{status}, recommend = #{recommend}, year_time = #{yearTime}, month_time = #{monthTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_article SET pv = IFNULL(pv, 0) + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE blog_article SET comments = IFNULL(comments, 0) + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM blog_article WHERE status = 1
SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(a.id) AS value FROM blog_category c LEFT JOIN blog_article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.create_time, a.pv, a.cover FROM blog_article a WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.pv, a.cover FROM blog_article a WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.pv DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a.id, a.category_id, a.title, a.description, a.cover, a.thumbnail, a.comment, a.comments, a.status, a.recommend, a.pv, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.year_time, a.month_time, c.name AS category_name FROM blog_article a LEFT JOIN blog_category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.status = 1 AND a.recommend = 1 ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
